title: Theming
summary: What a theme is. Modifiers such as light and dark are data, not generated colors.

questions.summary: A theme can be one token set, or token sets plus modifiers.

options.label: Token sets plus modifiers
options.why: A theme is a set of token sets plus modifiers such as light and dark.
options.when_to_choose: Choose this if light and dark are modifiers on one theme.
trade_offs: You maintain more than one set.

options.label: Single token set
options.why: One token set is the whole theme. There is no light or dark modifier.
options.when_to_choose: Choose this if you ship a single appearance.
trade_offs: Dark mode is a new theme later.
